Theme 061 · Signature directions

Dark Keynote

A cinematic launch stage — deep navy rather than black, with vignette and fine grain. One spotlight cone directs the eye per frame, panels float with a slight 3D tilt and depth-of-field blur, and the agent is wrapped in a layered teal edge glow that shifts to coral for exactly one beat when it finds something.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Navy stage + vignette — #0C1830 base, lighter centre, edges fall to navy shadow — never pure black (keeps compression clean)
  • Spotlight cone — soft trapezoid from above plus an elliptical pool on the floor; one focal point per frame
  • AI edge glow — conic teal ring with a blurred bloom copy; slow rotation = agent is working
  • Floating panel — dark glass card with gradient edge light and 6–16° tilt
  • Depth of field — foreground cards 9 px blur, background 2–3 px; only the hero element is sharp
  • Film grain — fixed-seed noise at ~16 % overlay so the dark gradients never band

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Spot click-on — cone opacity 0 → 1 in 2 frames with a 0.4 s flicker-settle, synced to the first downbeat
  • Glow ignition — four stroke layers scale 0.96 → 1 and fade in inside→out over one beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM); conic rotation 360° per 8 bars (16 s), linear
  • Focus pull — background blur 0 → 3 px while the panel sharpens 3 → 0 px, power2.inOut 0.6 s, triggered on the anomaly downbeat

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Dark, lit stages borrow the gravity of a keynote and make an AI agent feel like a premium, deliberate product — the glow is a visual shorthand for “thinking”. Risk: dark films crush on social compression and can feel generic-AI; keep midtones, grain, and a single coral moment so the glow means something.

Adapt to your product: Wrap whatever surface your AI acts on (editor, inbox, dashboard) in the edge glow, keep your real UI soft in the background, and let the glow change colour only when the AI surfaces a result that needs a human.

References: https://github.com/kyh/uicapsule/pull/34 (edge-glow border effect recreated in code (conic gradient + blur layers)) · https://stripe.com/sessions/2025 (dark, lit keynote-stage presentation of a product launch)
